headword: {表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}
gloss: two sides of the same coin; inseparable

definitions.gloss: two sides of the same coin, inseparable, forming one body
definitions.explanation: Two things that appear opposite or different but are in fact inseparable aspects of the same thing, like the front and back of a single sheet. Used to express that seemingly contradictory qualities are fundamentally connected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}だ。
examples.english: Freedom and responsibility are two sides of the same coin.

examples.japanese: ⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦リターン→リターン：29672_ritaan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Risk and return are inseparably linked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧さ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦テクノロジー→テクノロジー：11587_tekunorojii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恩恵|おんけい}→恩恵：04115_onkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Convenience and danger are inseparable, and to enjoy the benefits of technology, one must also understand its risks.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) used to express that two seemingly opposite concepts are fundamentally inseparable. Often followed by だ, ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧, or ⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧. Very common in essays, editorials, and formal discussions.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (front/surface) + {裏|り} (back/reverse) + ⟦{一体|いったい}→一体：01731_ittai⟧ (one body). Literally "front and back as one body."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}だ: A and B are two sides of the same coin
- {表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: an inseparable relationship
- {表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なす: to form two sides of the same coin
